The '''''Daring''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was used as an in-[[Star system/Legends|system]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].

==History==
About ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the ''Daring'' was refitted to participate in the [[Confederation Rock Rush]], the exploration of the [[Cularin asteroid belt]]. During the Run, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Dindau]] was [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of it, the [[Albino/Legends|albino]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Kohlbacca]] was first mate and [[Herren]], another Human, was the ship's engineer and gunner. However, the ship was severely damaged after a collision with an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]. Dindau sent out a distress call and it was picked up by the ''[[Neeva-Beelo]]'', a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] that was carrying the [[Heroes of Cularin]]. They attempted a rescue and tried to get the three crew members off the ''Daring'' before its [[Life support/Legends|life support]] systems failed.
